title: Choose the visual world for Cosmic Mart
question: The roll assigned candidate 4 of my grounded list. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Split-Flap Departures Board
options.thesis: Every return is a flight — landed, held, or cancelled. The operator reads the board, not a dashboard.
options.viewport: Full-width board: KPI strip across the top reads FLAGGED · ESCALATIONS · APPROVED · DECLINED as panel-mounted counters. Returns queue as disciplined board rows — ID, product, customer, date, amount, status chip. The AI sidebar reads as a service-status information panel. Status chips execute a CSS 3D flip animation when an agent decision arrives.
options.risk: Still dark — reads as 'purposefully dark' only if the charcoal-and-warm-white grammar is executed with complete discipline. No glow, no blur, no blue-black space cast.

raised.raise: Tonal precision: each status level maps to a deliberate luminance step, never decorative color.
Damped-spring flip: status chip rotates in with physical overshoot on agent decision.
Color role discipline: each status type owns exactly one color appearing nowhere else.
Achromatic body text, chromatic status edges — color earned, not scattered.

options.label: Apollo Operations Manual
options.lineage: NASA Apollo mission procedure documents and operations manuals, 1960s–70s
options.thesis: Mission control on white: returns managed as a flight procedure, each agent decision a logged step with a status stamp.
options.viewport: White ground. KPI row as procedure status boxes — rectangular, labeled, stamped with color. Returns table as a procedure log: step numbers left, product/customer columns, status as a stamped badge. AI sidebar as a mission events column. The agent system elements use NASA blue; status is stamped, not lit.
options.risk: The direction most runs landing on 'NASA + space ops' produce — familiar and effective. Naming the familiarity honestly.

options.label: Night Instrument Six-Pack
options.lineage: Small aircraft night VFR instrument panel
options.thesis: Six live gauges hold the operator's attention the way cockpit instruments hold a pilot's in cloud.
options.viewport: Six KPI gauges pinned above the returns table — Flagged, Escalations, Approved, Declined, Pending, Total Exposure. Needles animate with damped spring physics. Returns rows below. AI sidebar as a placard column beside the panel.
options.case: High audience identification — judges know cockpit instruments. Loses product clarity: the gauge topology makes individual return rows and row-level actions awkward.

options.label: Darkroom Zone Sheets
options.lineage: Ansel Adams zone system, darkroom exposure records
options.case: Fuses poorly: zone/hatch metaphor for returns status requires explanation the 5-second judge read cannot afford.
options.kept: Luminance precision — raised into the assigned direction.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.lineage: Metropolitan rail enamel mural, Harry Beck tradition
options.case: High audience identification; product clarity fails — return rows cannot be represented as network routes at operational density.
options.kept: Color role discipline — one committed color per status, raised into the assigned direction.

options.label: Saturated Ground Capsules
options.lineage: Contemporary floating pill / capsule nav aesthetic
options.case: Too casual for an ops demo context; saturated ground competes with data density.
options.kept: Regional color commitment — one structural color per functional zone, raised into the assigned direction.

options.label: Sneaker Box Stack
options.lineage: Sneaker archive wall, end-label browse pattern
options.case: Charming at small scale; breaks at 24+ simultaneous returns — the pull-and-open lid interaction cannot scale to operational density.
options.kept: Condensed end-label grid — raised into the assigned direction's row typography.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.lineage: Cloud diffraction, narrow spectral fringe, achromatic body
options.case: The achromatic-body/chromatic-edge grammar is clean but the source system has no audience identification in this context.
options.kept: Achromatic text field, color only at state edges — raised into the assigned direction.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What ops dashboards ship: white/light ground, neutral cards, blue or violet primary, a sidebar.
canonCard.viewport: Clean white background. Standard sticky nav. KPI cards row. Data table with status badges. Sidebar panel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Retool, Linear, or Datadog — the design genre the brief asked to leave.
